title: Control plane: add API to trigger provisioning runs + query run status (authz + rate limits)
author: Ethan Park
body: Summary: Adds control plane endpoints to (1) trigger a provisioning run for a Dedicated pool and (2) query run status, with explicit RBAC/authz checks and protective rate limits. This is the operator-facing API surface used by the new provisioning CLI and internal tooling; it forwards requests to fleet-provisioner and exposes a stable run/status shape for UI + automation. Endpoints: POST /v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/provisioning-runs (trigger) and GET /v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/provisioning-runs/{run_id} (status), plus GET /v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/provisioning-runs?limit=..&cursor=.. (list). Authz: New permissions dedicated.pools.provision (trigger) and dedicated.pools.provision.read (read/list). Trigger requires org-scoped admin or Dedicated-ops role; read/list allowed to org admin + support-oncall with read-only scope. Rate limits: (a) per-org trigger QPS (token bucket) to prevent accidental loops, (b) per-pool concurrency guard to prevent multiple active runs (Requested/Provisioning/Imaging/Bootstrapping/Validating) from stacking, and (c) per-run status polling cap (soft) with Retry-After. All denials return structured errors with operator-friendly remediation text. Audit: Trigger action emits an audit log entry with actor, org_id, pool_id, request_id, and returned run_id. Testing: Adds request/permission tests (authz matrix), rate-limit tests, and contract tests around fleet-provisioner responses (including timeout + partial failures). Rollout: Endpoint is behind feature flag provisioningRunsApiV1 (enabled in staging only); CLI will continue to use legacy/manual hooks until flag is enabled. Notes: This PR intentionally does not change routing readiness semantics; Ready gating is handled in a separate PR. Related: ENG-2742 state machine, ENG-2743 orchestration wrapper, PR-48232 structured provisioning events.
commits: control-plane(api): add provisioning runs routes + handlers
control-plane(rate-limit): add per-org trigger limiter + per-pool active-run guard
control-plane(audit): log provisioning_run.triggered with run_id + actor
tests: authz matrix + rate-limit behavior + fleet-provisioner timeout handling
docs: add OpenAPI annotations + example requests/responses
conversation: Vanessa Ortiz: API shape looks good. Two questions: (1) can we include a correlation_id in the trigger response so SRE can jump to logs, and (2) can we prevent multiple triggers while a run is in Validating? We saw duplicate runs in pilot when someone retried too quickly.

Ethan Park (author): Added correlation_id passthrough from fleet-provisioner (falls back to request_id if missing). Also expanded "active" states to include Validating so POST returns 409 Conflict w/ active_run_id if any run is not terminal.
Rafael Mendes: Rate limits: what key are we using? Please ensure we don't accidentally share buckets across regions/tenants. Also add Retry-After on 429 so CLI can backoff cleanly.

Ethan Park (author): Keys are org_id for trigger limiter and pool_id for concurrency guard (both scoped by env). Added Retry-After header with remaining reset seconds; updated error payload with backoff_seconds.

Benji Okafor: Authz: support-oncall should be able to read/list run status but not trigger. Can you confirm dedicated.pools.provision.read covers that and that trigger is admin-only? Also, can we avoid leaking infra details in errors (e.g., IAM role names) to broader roles?

Ethan Park (author): Confirmed: read/list requires dedicated.pools.provision.read; trigger requires dedicated.pools.provision. Updated redaction in error mapping: we now return sanitized categories (QUOTA, IAM, NETWORK, GPU_HEALTH, CONFIG_VALIDATION) and keep raw details only in internal logs/audit with request_id.
Connor O'Brien: Please ensure feature flag defaults to OFF in prod. Also add a note to release checklist that we need to coordinate with CLI rollout.
Ethan Park (author): Done: provisioningRunsApiV1 defaults false; added comment in feature_flags.ts and linked to ENG-2750 rollout section in the PR description.
Vikram Singh: Minor: pagination defaults for list endpoint? We should cap limit to avoid accidental large payloads.
Ethan Park (author): Added default limit=25, max=100, and cursor validation; unit tests included.
Vanessa Ortiz: Approved after the active-run guard change. Thanks.
Rafael Mendes: Approved. Please follow up in a separate PR to align error codes with incident-bot templates once those land.
release_notes: Internal: Add control plane endpoints to trigger and monitor Dedicated provisioning runs (feature-flagged; staging only).
